shortDescription: Manage network interfaces on Proxmox nodes

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: autostart
options.description: Automatically start interface on boot. Supported for C(eth), C(bridge), C(bond), C(vlan), and C(OVSBridge) interface types.

options.name: bond_mode
options.description: Bonding mode for C(bond) or C(OVSBond) interface types. Valid values for C(bond) interface type: C(balance-rr), C(active-backup), C(balance-xor), C(broadcast), C(802.3ad), C(balance-tlb), C(balance-alb) Valid values for C(OVSBond) interface type: C(active-backup), C(balance-slb), C(lacp-balance-slb), C(lacp-balance-tcp)

options.name: bond_primary
options.description: Primary interface for active-backup bond. Required for C(active-backup) bonding mode. Supported for C(bond) interface type only. Primary interface should be specified in C(slaves) parameter as well.

options.name: bond_xmit_hash_policy
options.description: Transmit hash policy for bond type. Required for C(balance-xor) and C(802.3ad) bonding modes.

options.name: bridge_ports
options.description: Specify the interfaces you want to add to your bridge. Supported for C(bridge) interface type only. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: bridge_vids
options.description: Specify the allowed VLANs (e.g., '2 4 100-200'). Only used if C(bridge_vlan_aware) is enabled. Supported for C(bridge) interface type only. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: bridge_vlan_aware
options.description: Enable bridge VLAN support. Supported for C(bridge) interface type only.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: cidr
options.description: IPv4 host address with prefix length (e.g., '192.168.1.10/24'). Supported for C(eth), C(bridge), C(bond), C(vlan), C(OVSBridge), and C(OVSIntPort) interface types. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: cidr6
options.description: IPv6 host address with prefix length (e.g., '2001:db8::10/64'). Supported for C(eth), C(bridge), C(bond), C(vlan), C(OVSBridge), and C(OVSIntPort) interface types. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments for the interface configuration. Supported for C(eth), C(bridge), C(bond), C(vlan), C(OVSBridge), C(OVSBond), and C(OVSIntPort) interface types. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: gateway
options.description: Default IPv4 gateway address. Supported for C(eth), C(bridge), C(bond), C(vlan), C(OVSBridge), and C(OVSIntPort) interface types. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: gateway6
options.description: Default IPv6 gateway address. Supported for C(eth), C(bridge), C(bond), C(vlan), C(OVSBridge), and C(OVSIntPort) interface types. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: iface
options.description: Network interface name. Required when C(state=present) or C(state=absent). For C(vlan) interface type, should be in format C(vlanXY) (e.g., C(vlan100)) or C(iface_name.vlan_id) (e.g., C(eth0.100)).

options.name: iface_type
options.description: Type of network interface. Required when C(state=present). Cannot be changed after interface creation.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (1280 - 65520). Supported for C(eth), C(bridge), C(bond), C(vlan), C(OVSBridge), C(OVSBond), and C(OVSIntPort) interface types. Can be deleted by setting to C(-1).

options.name: node
options.description: The Proxmox node to manage network interfaces on.

options.name: ovs_bonds
options.description: Interfaces used by OVS bonding device. (space separated) Required for C(OVSBond) interface type.

options.name: ovs_bridge
options.description: OVS bridge name. Required for C(OVSBond) and C(OVSIntPort) interface types.

options.name: ovs_options
options.description: OVS interface options. Supported for C(OVSBridge), C(OVSBond), and C(OVSIntPort) interface types. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: ovs_ports
options.description: Interfaces to add to OVS bridge. Supported for C(OVSBridge) interface type only. Can be deleted by setting to empty string C('').

options.name: ovs_tag
options.description: VLAN tag (1 - 4094). Supported for C(OVSBond) and C(OVSIntPort) interface types. Can be deleted by setting to C(-1).

options.name: slaves
options.description: Interfaces used by the bonding device (space separated). Required for C(bond) interface type.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the network interface. C(present) and C(absent) stage changes but do not apply them to the running configuration. C(apply) applies all staged network configuration changes to the running configuration. C(revert) discards all staged network configuration changes.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: vlan_raw_device
options.description: Raw device for VLAN interface. Required if iface is in format 'vlanXY'. Supported for C(vlan) interface type only.
